words.def_en: A violent tropical storm with very strong winds and heavy rain.
words.example_en: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, made landfall on the country's eastern coast on Sunday, bringing torrential rain and strong winds and triggering warnings of flooding and landslides.
